latin: Intellectuales dii uniones habent ab uno primo; substantias ab intelligibilibus; uitas perfectas et contentiuas, generatiuas diuinorum, ab intelligibilibus et intellectualibus; intellectualem proprietatem a seipsis.
translation: The intellectual gods have their unities from the first One; their substances from the intelligibles; their perfect and conserving lives, generative of divine things, from the intelligibles-and-intellectuals; and their intellectual property from themselves.
